projection.method: All anchor/HEAD-reachable commits, including merged-branch development; sorted raw git ls-tree -r -z mode/type/object/path entries; omit empty projections and globally deduplicate identical projected trees. No blob reads or lazy fetching.
projection.identity: SHA256 of path-byte-sorted raw ls-tree records, each followed by NUL; set digest is SHA256 of sorted distinct nonempty identity hex lines with final LF. Gitlinks are opaque pinned identities, not recursively audited upstream history.

seed.scope: Distinct committed Lip production-input states through the audited anchor, including branch development. Not a lifetime/uncommitted count, exported-build count, PR number, test count or run count.

policy: New admitted production-source candidates consume one ordinal. Retain failed issued ordinals forever. Same-candidate source-identical packaging/signing/CI retries do not advance; docs/tests-only or identical projected states cannot allocate. Minimum three decimal digits, no Alpha/Preview suffix. Final source/artifact binding is external after commit; reservations are not releases.
